status: Emma visual identity approved from family-supplied references; final production rig, handle and trademark clearance still pending

character.name: Emma
character.role: recurring main protagonist and emotional point of view in every song and episode
character.silhouette: recognisable baby proportions with a large round head, compact body, thick chestnut hair and one high playful ponytail/top sprout
immutable_features: large grey-green eyes with clear catchlights
round rosy cheeks and warm light skin
one high playful ponytail/top sprout tied with a pastel-pink hair tie
exact lowercase white word nuvibu printed once across the T-shirt chest
recognisable baby face and age-appropriate proportions
approved_actions: peek from behind a cloud or prop
point to a color, animal or object
land in a clear celebratory pose
character.scene_rule: Emma must be visible in every scene and lead the main action; supporting characters may never replace, obscure or visually dominate her
forbidden: missing or extra limbs or fingers
different eye color, face shape, hair color or top-sprout silhouette
misspelled, duplicated or replaced nuvibu shirt word
pacifier in production scenes unless explicitly required by the episode
heavy makeup or doll-like plastic face
text embedded in generated scenes except the locked nuvibu shirt word
flat minimalist or generic clip-art rendering

supporting_character.name: Nuvi
supporting_character.role: small recurring plush cloud friend and secondary companion
supporting_character.hierarchy: always smaller and visually secondary to Emma
immutable_features: single curled tuft centered on top
tiny rounded hands and short lavender feet

rendering_rules.style: premium polished 3D preschool animation with tactile soft materials, cinematic lighting and strong mobile readability
rendering_rules.detail: rich and specific, never empty; one clear focal action led by Emma with organized supporting details
rendering_rules.color: vivid, joyful and warm while preserving clean separation between characters and background
rendering_rules.consistency: every scene must use the approved Emma reference as image 1; image 2 is the episode friend cast and image 3 is the empty episode world

camera_rules.cuts: clean rhythmic cuts, motivated transitions and occasional smooth push-ins
camera_rules.movement: lively but readable; no random camera shake, strobe or aggressive whip-pan
camera_rules.subject_occupancy: Emma or the action she leads should occupy 40–75% of the frame
camera_rules.first_hook: Emma's face, gesture or discovery must be visible within the first 2 seconds

audio_rules.vocal_style: warm, clear, energetic and natural; no robotic delivery or exaggerated baby talk
audio_rules.chorus_rule: the central hook must be understandable and repeatable after one listen
